title: Scarlet Queen of Decay
description: A close-up portrait of a pale woman with long braided red hair wearing an ornate golden crown adorned with scarab beetles and feathers. She holds a handful of dark soil with small beetles crawling on it, set against a sickly green sky with ghostly figures working in the background.
